name: A00_4_minus_two_is_a_may_and_can_be_declined
notes: Printed: '[-2]: You MAY cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.' Shock is the only legal target (so no target ask). The cast is offered as the -2 resolves and is declined ('skip'): Shock stays in the graveyard, nothing is spent (the {R} stays in the pool), the opposing Bear lives, nobody is hurt. The loyalty cost was paid all the same (5 -> 3).
